source_documents.title: Contribution of radiative rate constants to crystallization-induced emission enhancement in boron-fused azobenzene complexes

reference_evidence_units.quote: The pristine BAz complex (BAz-H) and halogenated derivatives
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz-H
reference_evidence_units.conditions: BAz-H crystal and dilute/PMMA controls at room temperature and 77 K; same source TD-M06-2X dimer and refractive-index models.
reference_evidence_units.statement: BAz-H is the unsubstituted parent comparator within the studied CIEE series.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Its identity is by source designation; legacy molecular graph remains unverified.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Comparison of (c) absolute FL quantum yield, (d) radiative rate constant, and (e) nonradiative rate constant between 1 wt% PMMA ﬁlms and crystals
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz-H
reference_evidence_units.conditions: BAz-H crystal and dilute/PMMA controls at room temperature and 77 K; same source TD-M06-2X dimer and refractive-index models.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Figure 2 labels room-temperature BAz-H PMMA/crystal yields 0.8%/6.1%, kr 0.15/0.68 and knr 19/10 x10^8 s^-1.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Figure inspected. Both radiative acceleration and nonradiative reduction contribute at room temperature.

reference_evidence_units.quote: restriction of structural relaxation in the excited state
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz-H
reference_evidence_units.conditions: BAz-H crystal and dilute/PMMA controls at room temperature and 77 K; same source TD-M06-2X dimer and refractive-index models.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Crystal contacts are proposed to suppress structural relaxation for the BAz series including H.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: General source interpretation, not target-specific measured torsional dynamics.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Comparison of (b) absolute FL quantum yield, (c) radiative rate constant, and (d) nonradiative rate constant
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz-H
reference_evidence_units.conditions: BAz-H crystal and dilute/PMMA controls at room temperature and 77 K; same source TD-M06-2X dimer and refractive-index models.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Figure 3 labels BAz-H 77 K yields 19%, 25%, 27%, kr 0.61, 0.63, 0.59 and knr 2.6, 1.9, 1.6 x10^8 s^-1 for 2MeTHF, Tol/2MP and crystal.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Figure inspected. Unlike halogenated derivatives, BAz-H crystal does not show an increase in measured 77 K kr.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the calculated coup- ling strength of BAz-H was relatively large (Δε = 0.16 eV).
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz-H
reference_evidence_units.conditions: BAz-H crystal and dilute/PMMA controls at room temperature and 77 K; same source TD-M06-2X dimer and refractive-index models.
reference_evidence_units.statement: BAz-H has greater calculated dimer excitonic splitting, 0.16 eV, than the halogenated members' 0.05-0.08 eV.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Dimer/energy-splitting approximation; not a directly measured coupling constant.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the small kr value of BAz-H could be caused by forming a tight H-aggregation
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz-H
reference_evidence_units.conditions: BAz-H crystal and dilute/PMMA controls at room temperature and 77 K; same source TD-M06-2X dimer and refractive-index models.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The authors propose H-aggregation as a cause of suppressed BAz-H radiative rate relative to halogenated crystals.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is a quenching contribution, not evidence that H aggregation itself enhances emission.

reference_evidence_units.quote: 2.09 for BAz-H, 2.03 for BAz-F, 2.19 for BAz-Cl
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz-H
reference_evidence_units.conditions: BAz-H crystal and dilute/PMMA controls at room temperature and 77 K; same source TD-M06-2X dimer and refractive-index models.
reference_evidence_units.statement: BAz-H crystal refractive index is estimated as 2.09 in the Lorentz-Lorenz model.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Not directly measured; a high predicted n does not override the target's measured nearly unchanged 77 K kr.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The large decrease in kr/n2 in the BAz-H crystal could be caused by the eﬀect of H-aggregation.
reference_evidence_units.subject: BAz-H
reference_evidence_units.conditions: BAz-H crystal and dilute/PMMA controls at room temperature and 77 K; same source TD-M06-2X dimer and refractive-index models.
reference_evidence_units.statement: After refractive-index normalization the H target remains distinct, which the authors attribute to intermolecular electronic coupling.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Oscillator strengths in crystals are only approximated by dimers; authors acknowledge quantitative discrepancies.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Retain the explicit structural-relaxation restriction interpretation; do not substitute it for the target-specific H-aggregate effect.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Crystal environment restricts relaxation and changes polarizability, though H-coupling offsets the expected radiative benefit.

reference_mechanisms.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: H-aggregate electronic coupling is the central explanation for BAz-H's radiative-rate deficit relative to the halogenated series.

reference_mechanisms.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Rate balance is temperature-dependent: both rate changes help at room temperature, but 77 K crystal yield improvement tracks lower knr with no kr acceleration.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Retain the explicit structural-relaxation restriction interpretation; do not substitute it for the target-specific H-aggregate effect.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Crystal environment restricts relaxation and changes polarizability, though H-coupling offsets the expected radiative benefit.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No guest binding, pore uptake or host inclusion mechanism is established; a solvent or self-assembly is not automatically host-guest chemistry.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific CT or TICT mechanism is established in this extraction.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific excited-state proton-transfer pathway is established.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No photoinduced electron-transfer quenching or turn-on is established; energy transfer and CT character are not by themselves PET.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: H-aggregate electronic coupling is the central explanation for BAz-H's radiative-rate deficit relative to the halogenated series.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Rate balance is temperature-dependent: both rate changes help at room temperature, but 77 K crystal yield improvement tracks lower knr with no kr acceleration.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: The paper's external-heavy-atom explanation concerns Cl/Br, not the unsubstituted H target.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific conical-intersection mechanism is established; rotation restriction alone does not prove CI access.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No higher-singlet-state emission or anti-Kasha mechanism is established; higher-state absorption alone is insufficient.
